Каждая сборка — отдельная папка со своим: Each instance is a separate folder with its own mods, configs, worlds, screenshots and logs. Mods of one instance don’t affect another, and worlds don’t mix. Game versions, libraries and assets are stored once and not duplicated — ten instances won’t take ten gigabytes.
Fabric — лёгкий и быстрый, быстрее всех: Fabric is light and fast and gets updated for new versions first. Most optimization mods (Sodium, Lithium), maps and UI mods are here.
NeoForge — продолжение Forge, основной в: NeoForge is the successor of Forge and the main choice for big modpacks on 1.20.2 and newer (Create, Mekanism and others).
Forge — старый стандарт. Нужен для сборо: Forge is the old standard. It’s needed for instances on 1.12.2–1.20.1 and for mods that haven’t moved to NeoForge.
Quilt — ответвление Fabric; запускает бо: Quilt is a fork of Fabric and runs most Fabric mods. Choose it only if a mod requires Quilt specifically.
Без загрузчика — чистая игра. Ресурспаки: Without loader — the plain game. Resource packs work, mods and shaders don’t.
Моды для разных загрузчиков несовместимы: Mods for different loaders are not compatible: a Fabric mod won’t run in a Forge instance and vice versa. Check which loader your mod is made for and create the instance for it.
Версия игры определяет, какие моды подой: The game version determines which mods fit: a mod for 1.20.1 won’t load in 1.21. The loader version is the build of Fabric/Forge itself; usually take the latest, it works with most mods. If a mod needs a specific loader version, its page says so.
По умолчанию подставляются значения из о: Values from the general settings are filled in by default. A game without mods needs 2–3 GB, a big modpack 6–8 GB. The launcher picks Java by game version; you can choose an installed one or download the official one right in the creation window.
Название, обложку, память, Java, аргумен: Name, cover, memory, Java, JVM arguments and auto-connect to a server can be changed on the instance page — the sliders button in the header. The game version and loader of an existing instance are not changed: mods for another version would have to be reinstalled anyway. It’s easier to make a copy and instance a new instance next to it.
